product_one_liner.value: Syren provides data engineering and AI solutions that help enterprises modernize data platforms, deploy AI applications, and optimize supply-chain operations.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing link was found in the site's navigation/footer, and /pricing returns a page-not-found message.

named_customers.notes: Both are explicitly identified as clients.

founded_year.notes: Syren's own website states 2020; Tracxn reports 2019.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts include Srikant Kalaga's data-quality framework architecture and Anmol Hans's Lakebase application architecture articles; their biographies identify engineering and AI architecture roles.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation, help-center, or developer-portal link was found in the site's navigation or footer.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live postings include Senior Data & AI Engineer and AI Engineer + Knowledge Graph/Ontology, both with application actions.

model_provider.notes: The manufacturing Control Tower case study explicitly names Azure OpenAI and VannaAI for conversational AI; it does not specify an OpenAI model version.

compliance_certs.notes: Publicly displayed compliance claims include ISO 27001:2022. HIPAA and GDPR are compliance frameworks rather than certifications.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn identifies Syren as unfunded and reports no funding rounds.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile reports that Syren has not raised any funding rounds.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current open-role list contains no SDR, BDR, or account executive. An older SDR advertisement displays an end date of 10/9/2026, before the requested cutoff.

launched_6mo.notes: A June 9, 2026 product announcement presents Syren Sales Journey AI as a shipping Databricks/Lakebase field-sales planning application, with early-access deployments.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Syren announced Vibhu Tiwari as its new Vice President, GTM & Channels on November 11, 2025, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Named in an SDR posting's sales/prospecting-platform requirements; these are hiring signals, not confirmation that every platform is deployed.
